root_cause: Company/blog content orchestrator generated from recommendations and editor rules but lacked a verified, tenant-scoped link to the existing social_learnings source of truth. Old evaluations were present only in canonical and could not safely drive brand copy; first repair to the hourly evaluator already merged via PR #4828.
fix: Add a read-only tenant-filtered source feed to the existing Powerhouse content orchestrator for company LinkedIn and blogs; pass at most three independently evidenced, fresh, positively validated patterns to AI editorial guidance without touching personal/sensitive content or deterministic Mira.
prevention_rule: Only same-brand, status PROVEN, sample >=5, confidence >=0.75, positive measured effect, actual evidence refs, not older than 30 days and unexpired observations; never fabricate lift, customers, prices, orders or transfer between tenants. No second publisher, scheduled job, experiment registry or unsafe auto-promotion.
terminal_rule: Protected Required/CodeQL, Supabase Edge exact source parity, 24/48/72h provider evidence, a qualifying brand learning and confirmed next approved company/blog artifact consuming it; no automatic winner from missing input.
